source_sql: WITH anchors AS (SELECT a.node_id FROM Section a JOIN edge own ON own.src_id=a.node_id AND own.rel_type='BELONGS_TO_SPEC' JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=own.dst_id JOIN edge family ON family.src_id=edition.node_id AND family.rel_type='IN_RELEASE_OF' JOIN Spec hub ON hub.node_id=family.dst_id WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL AND hub.specNumber='38.214' AND a.sectionNumber='5.1') SELECT DISTINCT endpoint.sectionId AS sectionId FROM anchors a JOIN edge first ON first.src_id=a.node_id AND first.rel_type='REFERENCES_SECTION' JOIN Section intermediate ON intermediate.node_id=first.dst_id JOIN edge second ON second.src_id=intermediate.node_id AND second.rel_type='REFERENCES_SECTION' JOIN Section endpoint ON endpoint.node_id=second.dst_id WHERE first.edge_id<>second.edge_id
